The '''Maldovea system''' was a part of the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Maldovean Burtalle]].<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Maldovean Burtalle]]|system=Maldovea [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Maldovea [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
